text: 不靠贬值换优势！潘功胜G20会议谈人民币汇率、货币政策、经济再平衡 近年来，随着出口结构转型升级，企业议价能力和汇率风险管理能力不断增强，中国贸易对汇率敏感性大幅下降。
text_en: No reliance on depreciation for advantage! Pan Gongsheng discusses yuan exchange rate, monetary policy, and economic rebalancing at G20 meeting. In recent years, with export structure upgrading and stronger corporate pricing power and FX risk management, China's trade sensitivity to exchange rates has fallen sharply.
